algorithmName: Dice-Roll-Simulator — Amortized Analysis of Full-List Re-rendering
rules: This simulation models the rendering cost of updating a list UI naively by re-rendering all items on every new insertion. On step k, appending one item causes k rendering DOM operations. Over N steps, the total operations accumulate to N*(N+1)/2, demonstrating an O(N^2) total quadratic runtime and an amortized O(N) cost per roll step.
instructions: At each step, click the highlighted tile that you think the algorithm will expand next. Explanations appear after every guess.
